title: YouTube Music adds labels for tracks made mainly with generative AI
friendlyTitle: YouTube Music will label songs made mainly by AI
summary: YouTube Music is rolling out player labels that mark songs created primarily with generative AI, including cases where a model produced the composition and vocals. The labels are also expanding to the main YouTube app, using partner disclosures and YouTube's own detection.
friendlySummary: YouTube Music is adding a label on the player when a song was created mainly with generative AI. The same labels are coming to the main YouTube app.
whyItMatters: Listeners can see when a track is largely machine-made without leaving the player. It is a disclosure tool, not a filter: a label does not by itself remove a song from recommendations or monetisation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can see when a track is mostly machine-made. The label informs you. It does not automatically hide the song.
